notes: This file is the handshake between the phone / Arena agent and the desktop GPU hub.
Set status to "pending" (and fill peptide.sequence) then push to the branch.
The desktop hub polls every 60 s, claims the task, runs GROMACS in WSL2 and
rewrites this file with status "completed_on_desktop" plus a reduced result block.
Generate a valid document with: python3 -m core.task_contract new --sequence GIGKFLHSAKKFGKAFVGEIMNS --name magainin2 --write results/status/cgmd_task.json
Schema: core/task_contract.py  |  Allowed statuses: idle, pending, claimed, running, completed_on_desktop, failed_on_desktop, cancelled
